title: Catch-up ingestion after downtime, NFL relink fix and stable live schedule scope (ENG-052)
objective: When the PC wakes after missing data, the worker recovers every finished game the live lanes never read (ESPN scoreboard, summary and plays; NFL full record), records capture gaps and recovery times for ADR-007 A1/A3, and week 10 2026 is recovered; NFL games link to ESPN within minutes of a startup race
next_action: Push branch claude/catch-up-and-decisions and open a PR; after CI is green the owner merges, then restart arbit-worker (no migration) between games so the catchup lane and relink fix run; confirm a 'catchup' started line and receipts.

review.summary: Read daemon lanes, LiveFeed, NflFeed, live store, availability capture, league_history and tests. Self-healing on restart: league lane reads current state, every unrecorded lineup week and every period's transactions; statistics imports current nflverse revisions; the injury-report capture reads the whole season each time. Not self-healing: LiveFeed and NflFeed follow only the current week (store.game_timings scope = most recently observed week; NflFeed.discover = today's week), so a week that started and ended while nothing ran is never read. Read-only DB query 2026-11-22: periods 1-7 never captured (worker began week 8), 8 complete ESPN, 9 complete ESPN+NFL, 10 nothing (14 games), 11 current. Publishing a past week's board with observed_at=now would make it the most recently observed week and flip the live schedule scope. NflFeed rediscovers only every 6 h, so a startup race left all week 11 NFL games unlinked.

plan.summary: (1) store.game_timings scopes by the season's latest (season_type, week), so a recovered past week never becomes the live schedule. (2) NflFeed: rediscover every 120 s while current-week games are unlinked; recover_week(season_type, week) links a past week's schedule and reads each linked game's full record once. (3) LiveFeed: read_week_board(week) for a past scoreboard; recover_game(event) reads the summary, plays unless the NFL record owns them, then completes final checks. (4) New arbit_worker.catchup: outstanding finished games (kickoff+5h) in periods from the first captured one (or --from-period), excluding the current week; recover oldest week first (ESPN board, NFL record from the first NFL-lane week, ESPN summary/plays); source-gap snapshot from source health; append-only private receipt (ARBIT_CATCHUP_PATH) with kickoff and read time per game, no bodies. (5) catchup lane in the default worker lanes: never while a slate is active, one week per step, 30 min idle checks. (6) arbit-worker catchup [--dry-run] [--from-period] [--games-only]: also runs due availability and statistics steps. Tests: real-PostgreSQL integration for scope, relink, plan, recovery, receipt, deferral. Docs: catch-up guide, ENG-052, R-068, R-069, status, changelog. Rollback: revert the commit; lanes are independent.

implementation.summary: store.game_timings scopes by the season's latest (season_type, week); store.complete_final_checks. LiveFeed.read_week_board and recover_game. NflFeed: _store_schedule split from discover with unlinked count, RELINK_SECONDS=120 rediscovery while unlinked (R-069), recover_week for past weeks. New arbit_worker.catchup (outstanding_games, source_gaps, recover_week, run, plan_summary, append-only receipts under ARBIT_CATCHUP_PATH). daemon: CatchupLane (defers while active, one week per step, gap snapshot at construction) in default LANES; catchup_once CLI with --dry-run, --from-period, --with-lanes; main.py dispatch (and restored availability-capture's return). 12 real-PostgreSQL tests in tests/integration/test_catchup.py; the scope and relink tests fail with each fix reverted. Docs: catch-up guide, .env.example, member operations note, ENG-052, R-068, R-069.

validation.summary: Observed exit 0 for foundation, live-replay, runtime-check (Ruff, strict mypy on 119 files, contracts, full pytest: 1341 passed in 52.6 s including real-PostgreSQL integration) and web-check (client generation, design rules, 32 Vitest tests, build, PWA). 12 new tests in tests/integration/test_catchup.py; the scope and relink tests fail with each fix reverted. Real-data dry run on a restored copy of arbit_local (arbit_catchup_test, 366 MB): first captured period 8, NFL records from 9, live week 11, outstanding exactly week 10's 14 unstored games. Not yet observed: network recovery against the copy and the real database (done in TASK-20261122-002 after the late games); the lane on the running worker (needs merge and restart).

journal.note: Kickoff + 5 h marks a game as settled for catch-up; later games belong to the live lanes. Overtime and weather delays rarely exceed it; a game still not final is reported not_final and retried on the next start.
